annotations.title: Cancel one approved plan's text while it waits for the customer's texting hours

description: Cancel one approved plan's text while it waits for the customer's texting hours. It is never sent; Summer records who cancelled it and adds a case activity entry. A text that is sending, sent or has an unknown result cannot be cancelled and keeps its state. The rest of the plan is unchanged and nothing is sent.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change
